title_en: Avengers: Doomsday's Latest Teaser Goes Hard on Steve Rogers, but Who Is 'Malachi von Doom?'
summary_en: Marvel Studios has released yet another Avengers: Doomsday trailer, this one focusing on Steve Rogers doing "what needs to be done" in Latveria.
body_en:
Marvel Studios has released yet another Avengers: Doomsday trailer, this one focusing on Steve Rogers doing "what needs to be done" in Latveria.
The clip, which is doing the rounds on social media, starts with Rodgers and Peggy Carter’s son asking him if he was a superhero, as we saw and heard in the final trailer released earlier this week.
“There were six of us,” he replies. “We were called the Avengers.”
🚨Novo spot de #AvengersDoomsday com cenas inéditas da Disney Turquia. https://t.co/tYiOJDL3ny
We then get a fun meta joke about Steve Rogers actor Chris Evans having played The Human Torch in the Fox-produced Fantastic Four films — a role he reprised in cameo form in Deadpool & Wolverine.
“So, can you fly?” asks his son, as Thor leaps at Doom for yet another look at that finger block. “Turn into fire,” he continues, as the MCU’s Human Torch, played by Joseph Quinn, hurtles out of a building to spray fire on what looks like a Doom magic-protected device below. “Or shoot lasers out of your eyes?” he adds, referencing Cyclops doing his thing.
“No, I can’t do any of that,” Steve replies with a smirk.
“So, what do you do?”
At this point we see new footage of Steve in Latveria, the fictional Eastern European nation ruled by Doctor Doom. He’s standing by some sort of circular device, with Doom’s name on it, and summons Mjölnir. After it flies into his hand, Steve draws lightning power to seemingly strike the device.
As we wonder what this is all about, Peggy answers: “He does what needs to be done.”
We then see Steve flying up towards the camera, hammer first, via the Bifrost. So, in a way, he can fly!
Let’s go back to the circular device Steve was about to hit with the lightning. From the wording on the side, it looks like a tomb of sorts for Victor von Doom’s family. We see ‘Malachi von Doom,’ who we presume is Doom’s deceased son.
If this is a tomb for Doom’s family, why is Steve about to smack it with Mjölnir? Is he trying to break into the grave? Could he be trying to resurrect Doom’s wife and kid? Is that what Peggy meant by "he does what needs to be done"?
The Avengers: Doomsday teasers are coming thick and fast as we head towards launch. Earlier this week we got a first look at Magneto vs Doom (and a failed attempt to rip Doom’s mask off), news of plans for a special tribute to Patrick Stewart , a first look at Kelsey Grammer's Beast , and fears over Bucky’s fate .
Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters December 18.
